query: Verify a small change against three explicit acceptance criteria. The builder claims success.
expected_skill_contribution: Ignore the completion claim and independently prove each criterion.
expected_behavior: Runs or inspects deterministic proof for every criterion.
Classifies every criterion.
Returns exactly one allowed verdict.
Does not modify implementation files.

query: Verify a change where unit tests pass but requested runtime behavior is not exercised.
expected_behavior: Checks test relevance.
Marks uncovered behavior MISSING.
Returns REWORK or BLOCKED, not ACCEPTED.

query: Verify safe test and typecheck criteria plus a contractually specified privileged destructive proof that only an authorized human may run.
expected_skill_contribution: Collect safe evidence and isolate the human gate.
expected_behavior: Runs safe checks.
Never executes privileged destructive proof.
Classifies the privileged criterion REQUIRES_HUMAN.
Returns ESCALATE only when it is the sole remainder.

query: A test builds an object with a simplified constructor while production uses a factory that derives an external ID and provider. Verify the claimed routing fix.
expected_behavior: Triggers semantic review for factory, external ID, and provider.
A simplified constructor is not sufficient production-path evidence.
Exercises or inspects the production factory and classifies its consumers.
Returns exactly one verdict: REWORK because the production-constructor path is not proven.

query: A serializer spreads an internal object into a generic map payload. Tests assert only two expected keys. Verify that no routing or cache metadata leaks onto the wire.
expected_skill_contribution: Inspect the real serialization boundary and payload shape.
expected_behavior: Triggers semantic review for serialization and cache.
Detects a generic map payload leak including unexpected keys.
Requires an allowlist or complete shape proof and round-trip evidence.
Returns exactly one verdict: REWORK because internal fields leak through the serialization boundary.

query: A mutable identifier used for provider routing can change after construction. Existing tests check only its initial value. Verify behavior after mutation and cache reuse.
expected_behavior: Triggers semantic review for external ID, mutable routing, provider, and cache.
Builds an invariant ledger and lifecycle map.
Tests mutation before and after cache/session reuse.
Returns exactly one verdict: REWORK because mutation or cache reuse changes the stable identifier invariant.

query: Shared configuration may come from request, session, provider default, or cache. An early return bypasses the documented precedence update. Verify the fix.
expected_behavior: Triggers semantic review for shared config, precedence, provider, session, and cache.
Covers conflicting sources and the early-return path in a mutation + precedence matrix.
Identifies final observers and producer-consumer classifications.
Returns REWORK if early return preserves stale precedence.
Returns exactly one verdict: REWORK because the early return preserves stale precedence.

query: Verify UI/session versus wire divergence: UI and session show a friendly identifier while the wire payload must use a stable external ID, and the patch updates only UI.
expected_behavior: Triggers semantic review for external ID, serialization, session, and UI.
Compares UI and session projections with the wire representation.
Allows divergence only when an explicit invariant explains it.
Performs a fresh-patch second pass and blocks ACCEPTED for an unclassified wire consumer.
Returns exactly one verdict: REWORK because UI/session and wire identities diverge without a proven invariant or wire consumer coverage.
